DEVICE ACCESS
Technical preview
USB devices

When a supported device is connected, the app requests USB access and connects to ADB. If the key is not trusted yet, confirm USB debugging on the connected device. Read-only ADB product and Fastboot queries require a button press; flashing is unavailable.
Refresh USB devices
Connect a device with a USB OTG cable, then refresh the list.
